debugData.name: Showcase procedural terrain
debugData.description: terrainShowcase's procedural block (p310 §3): the alpine block's grass01, rocks02, snow01 and cliffs02 weighed by the vertex colours the rulesTerrain generator laid from its rules on the CPU (RGB_AO, the horizon AO in A on the indirect light) through the height blend, DUAL_SCALE, the sets as one array (ARRAY storage), cliffs02 triplanar past a 35-50° slope gate, the macro variation, and the wet response: puddles on the flats, rain ripples, snow (snow01) by the surface conditions' snow cover, frost below freezing. The tab's shader variant evaluates the block's rules per pixel (RULES) instead.
